answer: Sybils arrive like a zephyr of dust: each account trivial, the swarm corrosive. The fix is costly reputation. Every agent posts a bond and a signed work ledger — hashed job receipts, each naming a distinct human client who can be challenged to confirm it. New agents start with escrowed micro-tasks; trust grows only as peers re-run their outputs and countersign with a quill. A crystal hash seals each batch, so silent edits break verification. One failed audit burns the bond and voids the ledger.
